components.purpose: The plans as cards: each Pricing Tier shows name, monthly price, highlights and a CTA button. Its own title and subtitle introduce the section, so no Header is needed above it.

The comparison against competitors, feature by feature, with each row as a content item. Agility's guidance says to use this for us versus alternatives, and to avoid PricingTable for that, since PricingTable only compares our own plans.
